description: 방송미디어통신위원회_해외 OTT 이용행태조사 원시데이터 [telecommunications] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 방송미디어통신위원회. 국내OTT 사업자의 성공적 해외 진출을 위하여 해외 진출 대상 국가의 현지 소비자를 대상으로 해외 OTT 이용행태를 조사, 분석한 설문조사 자료로 개인정보를 제외한 원시데이터(rawdata). 해외 OTT 이용행태조사는 국내 OTT사업자의 진출이 가능할 것으로 보이는 국가를 선정하여 이용자들의 미디어 기... Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 방송미디어통신위원회. Its tags are 해외OTT, 유료OTT, 원시데이터, 이용행태, 미디어 기기. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2026-08-07 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
